title: how do i work this thing (Aseprite)

posts.author: AwsmPossumSauce
posts.body: i got mv yesterday and i want to get started on making sprites and maps and stuff. people keep saying to use gimp but i have a fancy pixel art program called aseprite and would like to use that instead. can some one please tell me what i need to do to make a custom tileset from scratch? and tips on making cutscenes, dialogue and stuff in general would be appreciated too

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: RPG Maker has a specific tileset format that the fastest way to make your own is to edit or use an existing already-formatted tileset as a template

posts.author: Nirriti
posts.body:
Since youre new to Aseprite, some friendly tips.
Theme Preference
(Extension). Its free on the official website! This'll make your UI much more pleasant while editing. Simply a must.
Youll need to use magnetism to help you out speed up your selection process. SHIFT+S = toggle "
Snap to Grid
"
(remember to toggle it off when drawing!)
When moving elements
(after copying or whatever)
, hold the
ALT button
. Itll magnetize where you move so that you'll never waste time and have perfect tile placements.
As AquaEcho said, using what others did as template will really help you understanding a lot about tilesets. If you wanna head out for an NES look, for example, the huge bundles
Marumugi4510
(on Steam and on Itch.io)
did will really help you on on editing
(its PDF manual will also explain to you weird/special things that arent obvious at first too)
, sorting & making your own sheets. That said you should try to recolor/redo a lot so itll feel more like YOURS and diff from those who also bought said set.
